purpose_fr: Par où j'entre : bloc vu du dessus, rue, camion, flèche vers E1, hydrant
notes: Street-frame top view (earth-top-01): footprint white cut to a window zoomed on the way in, street band through the truck, one big arrow (width 18) truck → E1 with its tag across the arrow; everything about danger comes from state.building.hazards at runtime (a triangle on the building and Halo.hazardLine card lines, E2 crossed out because the reported hazard is on its level).

references_used.caption: Street View, façade
references_used.took: the white panelled façade of 98 Bd Bessières runs straight along the boulevard with a wide pavement, a low railing and a tree line between façade and roadway: the truck stands on the roadway and the last metres cross the pavement, so the arrow is drawn straight from the truck onto the door, perpendicular to the street band

references_used.caption: Street View, gauche
references_used.took: the glazed entrance lobby at the base of the white façade, at the left end of the frontage, with the railing interrupted in front of it: confirms E1 is the door on the boulevard side where the state puts it (491,474). No hydrant visible, and H1's point is on this photo frame, not a drawing frame, so H1 is left out

references_used.caption: Street View, droite
references_used.took: looking down the boulevard: two carriageways with a central tram/bus platform, the façade of 98 continuing on the left and no vehicle access on that side, so nothing is drawn to the right of the footprint and the only approach shown is from the truck in front of the entrance

references_used.caption: Google Earth, vue du dessus
references_used.took: Bd Bessières runs as a wide straight band diagonally along the south-east side of the block, buildings packed against it with a tree-lined pavement between: this is the frame the view draws on (footprint polygon, E1, E2 and the truck spot all live on it) and why the street band is drawn across the truck, parallel to the façade the arrow enters

references_used.caption: Plan IFC niveau -1
references_used.took: the basement behind E2: the access ramp -1.03 and the garage -1.11 on the left of the plan, with ESC A at the bottom centre; that is the level the live state reports a hazard on, which is why E2 is crossed out and its danger line comes from the state, not from the drawing

references_used.caption: Plan IFC niveau 0
references_used.took: the ground floor behind E1: the stair hall ESC A sits just inside the door at the bottom centre with corridor:0 between them, which is why the card reads Entrez par E1 then the stair line for A
